titulo: What all American Moved Outside West? #whatif  #america  #california  #animation  #shorts
descripcion:
What if all 340 million Americans packed up and moved west? 🤠 Sunshine, beaches, mountains, and California, already the 4th biggest economy on Earth.

But here's the catch... much of the West runs on the Colorado River, and Lake Mead just hit its lowest level ever. Add 260 million more people and the taps run dry, home prices explode, and the East becomes a ghost town.

Would YOU still go? Be honest 👇

Facts: About 342 million people live in the U.S. and about 80 million live in the West (U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 estimates). California is the world's 4th largest economy (Office of the Governor of California, citing IMF/BEA data). The Colorado River supplies water to more than 40 million people, and Lake Mead fell to a record low in August 2026 (U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, via AP/PBS).
